question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose ‘No error’.

The Event Horizon Telescope can help scientists analyse the shapes and behaviours of event horizons.
solution:
The correct answer is '**No error**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The usage of '**analyse**' is correct as it refers to examining something in great detail. In this context, it is used appropriately to describe the action being performed by scientists on the event horizons.
 
• The terms '**shapes**' and 'behaviours of event horizons' are relevant scientific concepts when talking about the study of event horizons with the help of the Event Horizon Telescope. This adds to the correctness of the content as well as the grammatical structure.
 
• The sentence logically and coherently presents the information, making it free of error in context to spelling, grammar, and usage.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 3) "The Event Horizon Telescope can**" initiates the sentence appropriately, specifying the capability of the Event Horizon Telescope, and there is no error in this part.
 
• **Option 4) "help scientists analyse the shapes**" is correctly phrased, indicating assistance provided by the telescope in a scientific analysis, thus making this option error-free.
 
• **Option 1) "and behaviours of event horizons**." complements the earlier part of the sentence correctly, providing additional details on what aspects the scientists are analyzing, which is free from any error.
